name: two languages render side by side; events, bound inputs and capabilities
live swap keeps state, fetches only new blobs, and runs the schema migration
a layer that fails its health check is refused; the running version is untouched
a trap during an event drops the event's writes and reverts to the newest earlier layer on the same schema
a trap with nothing to revert to restarts the same version
an event that runs past the time limit is cut off, its writes dropped, and the slot reverted
a migration that never finishes rejects the manifest
signatures and app pinning
a host with no trusted keys refuses everything (fail closed)
a host with no pinned app refuses signed manifests
versions: replay, equal, bad values, too far ahead
epochs order releases ahead of versions, up to the trusted keyring
a plain host trusts epoch 0 only
blobs: tampered, missing, content-addressed
LLP 1 manifests are strict
v0 manifests ignore unknown fields
declared keys: malformed declarations are refused
declared keys: a slot sees only what it owns or reads, and can't write outside what it owns
without declared keys, no layer may write host keys
declared capabilities: an undeclared one is answered 'error: not granted'
a capability the host doesn't offer is answered 'error: not granted'
a capability that fails is answered 'error: <message>'
placement: a client fetches and runs only client slots
a client drops layer writes to shared/ (the server owns them)
slots missing from a new manifest are removed; order decides what renders
a revert never runs old code on data in a newer schema
development mode runs unsigned manifests
signatures cover the canonical form: a relay that re-orders keys changes nothing
